He was very helpful so with the help of society he contested Panchayat elections for the first time from the lowest level and secured the seat of ward member by the margin of 3 votes (2001-06). He was getting prepared for the next term and came back, fought and created the gap of 2025 votes in between him and second position (2021-26). Soonafter, one month he was elected from within the members as the Zila parishad upadhyaksh aheading by 6 votes (2021-26).
